l-e-e1-b05-02.title: Okwu ogologo ọ̀ bụ ihe buru ibu?
l-e-e1-b05-02.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na ọ bụrụ na okwu dị ogologo, ihe ahụ nwekwara buru ibu bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ na-ezighị ezi (counterexample).
l-e-e1-b05-02.material: Nkwupụta: Ọ bụrụ na okwu bekee dị ogologo karịa, ihe ahụ nwekwara buru ibu karịa. Ụzọ ndị dị n'okpuru nọ n'usoro 'okwu mkpụmkpụ - okwu ogologo'. Chọta ụzọ na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e1-b05-02.s.s1.r.b: Okwu ogologo chair bụ ihe buru ibu karịa. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta.
l-e-e1-b05-02.s.s1.r.c: Okwu ogologo desk bụ ihe buru ibu karịa. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta.
l-e-e1-b05-02.s.s1.r.d: Okwu ogologo board bụ ihe buru ibu karịa. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta.
l-e-e1-b05-02.s.s1.explain: Pencil nwere mkpụrụedemede 6 ma dị ogologo karịa desk (mkpụrụedemede 4), ma ọ bụ ihe dị obere karịa desk nke ukwuu.
l-e-e1-b05-02.s.s2.model.0: Pencil bụ okwu dị ogologo karịa desk ma ihe ahụ dị obere, ya mere nkwupụta na-ezighị ezi.
l-e-e1-b05-02.s.s2.model.1: Pencil, okwu nwere mkpụrụedemede 6, bụ ihe dị obere karịa desk, okwu nwere mkpụrụedemede 4, ya mere ikwu na ogologo pụtara ibu na-ezighị ezi.

l-e-e1-b01-06.title: Ịchọta iwu e ji hazie kaadị mkpụrụ edemede alfabet
l-e-e1-b01-06.goal: Chọpụta nke iwu (otu ozi) dị mkpa n'ezie iji chọta iwu nke kewara kaadị ndị ahụ n'ìgwè abụọ, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-e1-b01-06.material: A kewara kaadị alfabet n'ìgwè abụọ. Ìgwè mbụ: A, E, I, O, U. Ìgwè nke abụọ: B, C, D, F, G.
l-e-e1-b01-06.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu ziri ezi maka ịkewa ìgwè abụọ ahụ?
l-e-e1-b01-06.s.s1.o.a: Mkpụrụ edemede vowel na mkpụrụ edemede consonant
l-e-e1-b01-06.s.s1.o.b: Mkpụrụ edemede buru ibu na mkpụrụ edemede nta
l-e-e1-b01-06.s.s1.r.b: Kaadị ndị ahụ niile bụ mkpụrụ edemede buru ibu, ya mere enweghị ike ịkewa ha site na nha.
l-e-e1-b01-06.s.s1.o.c: Ihu na azụ nke usoro alfabet
l-e-e1-b01-06.s.s1.r.c: A, E, I, O, U gbasaara site n'ihu ruo n'azụ.
l-e-e1-b01-06.s.s1.o.d: Mkpụrụ edemede nwere naanị ahịrị kwụ ọtọ na ndị na-enweghị
l-e-e1-b01-06.s.s1.r.d: O na U nwere akụkụ gbagọrọ, ya mere nke a enweghị ike ịbụ iwu.
l-e-e1-b01-06.s.s1.explain: A, E, I, O, U bụ vowels ma B, C, D, F, G bụ consonants. A kewara ha site n'ụdị ụda.
l-e-e1-b01-06.s.s2.model.0: Iwu na-achịkọta A, E, I, O, U n'onwe ha bụ na ha bụ vowels. Nha enweghị ike ịbụ iwu n'ihi na ha niile bụ mkpụrụ edemede buru ibu.
l-e-e1-b01-06.s.s2.model.1: Ìgwè mbụ bụ vowels ise, ya mere iwu bụ vowels na consonants. Usoro adabaghị n'ihi na ihu na azụ agwakọtara.

l-e-e1-b01-07.title: Iwu maka ịkewa ihe dị n'ime ụlọ klaasị
l-e-e1-b01-07.topic: Ihe a na-eji ihe ahụ eme
l-e-e1-b01-07.s.s1.o.b: Ihe a na-eji ihe ahụ eme
l-e-e1-b01-07.goal: Chọpụta nke iwu (otu ozi) dị mkpa n'ezie iji chọta iwu nke kewara kaadị ihe dị n'ime ụlọ klaasị, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-e1-b01-07.material: Kewaa kaadị ihe dị n'ime ụlọ klaasị n'ìgwè abụọ. Otu ìgwè: pencil, pen, crayon. Ìgwè nke ọzọ: chair, stool, bench.
l-e-e1-b01-07.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu dị mkpa n'ezie iji kewaa ìgwè abụọ ahụ?
l-e-e1-b01-07.s.s1.r.a: Mkpụrụ edemede mbụ agwakọtara dị ka p, c, s, b, ya mere nke a enweghị ike ịbụ iwu.
l-e-e1-b01-07.s.s1.r.c: Ọnụọgụ mkpụrụ edemede bụ 3, 6, 6 na 5, 5, 5, ya mere ha anaghị ekewa n'ìgwè ndị ahụ.
l-e-e1-b01-07.s.s1.r.d: Kaadị ndị ahụ anaghị egosi agba, ya mere ị pụghị ịmara.
l-e-e1-b01-07.s.s1.explain: A kewara ha n'ihe ị na-ede na ihe ị na-anọdụ. Ị pụghị ịmara agba, ma udi mkpụrụ edemede enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ojiji.
l-e-e1-b01-07.s.s2.model.0: pencil, pen, na crayon bụ ihe ị na-ede, ma chair, stool, na bench bụ ihe ị na-anọdụ, ya mere ojiji bụ iwu.
l-e-e1-b01-07.s.s2.model.1: Agba anọghị n'kaadị ma ọnụọgụ mkpụrụ edemede agwakọtara, ya mere ịkewa site na ojiji ziri ezi.

l-e-e1-b01-08.title: Iwu maka ịkewa kaadị okwu ezinụlọ
l-e-e1-b01-08.goal: Chọpụta nke iwu (otu ozi) dị mkpa n'ezie iji chọta iwu nke kewara kaadị okwu ezinụlọ, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-e1-b01-08.material: A kewara kaadị okwu ezinụlọ. Nke mbụ: mother, sister, grandmother. Nke abụọ: father, brother, grandfather.
l-e-e1-b01-08.s.s1.o.a: Ndị ezinụlọ nwanyị na ndị ezinụlọ nwoke
l-e-e1-b01-08.s.s1.o.b: Ndị ezinụlọ tọrọ ogologo na ndị ezinụlọ dị obere
l-e-e1-b01-08.s.s1.r.b: Ị pụghị ịmara afọ site n'kaadị naanị.
l-e-e1-b01-08.s.s1.o.c: Ndị ezinụlọ bi ọnụ na ndị ezinụlọ bi iche
l-e-e1-b01-08.s.s1.r.c: Ị pụghị ịmara ebe ha bi site n'kaadị naanị.
l-e-e1-b01-08.s.s1.r.d: mother na father nwere otu ọnụọgụ mkpụrụ edemede ma dị n'ìgwè dị iche.
l-e-e1-b01-08.s.s1.explain: Ìgwè mbụ bụ ndị ezinụlọ nwanyị niile ma ìgwè nke abụọ bụ ndị ezinụlọ nwoke niile. A kewara ha site n'ihe okwu pụtara.
l-e-e1-b01-08.s.s2.model.0: mother, sister, na grandmother bụ nwanyị ma ndị ọzọ bụ nwoke, ya mere nwanyị na nwoke bụ iwu.
l-e-e1-b01-08.s.s2.model.1: Afọ na ebe ha bi anọghị n'kaadị, ya mere ị pụghị ịmara ha. Naanị nwanyị na nwoke dabara.

l-e-e1-b01-09.title: Ozi achọrọ iji họrọ ekele ziri ezi
l-e-e1-b01-09.goal: Chọpụta nke iwu (otu ozi) dị mkpa n'ezie iji chọta ekele ziri ezi, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-e1-b01-09.material: Ị chọrọ ịkele enyi site na Good morning, Good afternoon, ma ọ bụ Good evening. E nwere ihe ị chọrọ ịmara iji họrọ ekele ziri ezi.
l-e-e1-b01-09.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ozi dị mkpa n'ezie iji họrọ ekele?
l-e-e1-b01-09.s.s1.o.b: Ọnụọgụ mkpụrụ edemede dị n'aha enyi
l-e-e1-b01-09.s.s1.r.b: Ọnụọgụ mkpụrụ edemede dị n'aha enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ekele.
l-e-e1-b01-09.s.s1.r.c: Ịdị elu enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ekele.
l-e-e1-b01-09.s.s1.r.d: Agba uwe enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ekele.
l-e-e1-b01-09.s.s1.explain: Ekele atọ ahụ na-ezo aka n'ụtụtụ, ehihie, na mgbede. Ya mere ị chọrọ ịmara oge ekele ka ịhọrọ.
l-e-e1-b01-09.s.s2.model.0: Ekele atọ ahụ na-agbanwe dabere n'oge, ya mere ị chọrọ ịmara ma ọ bụ ụtụtụ, ehihie, ma ọ bụ mgbede.
l-e-e1-b01-09.s.s2.model.1: Ịmara ịdị elu ma ọ bụ agba uwe anaghị ekpebi ekele, ya mere oge dị mkpa n'ezie.

l-e-e1-b01-10.title: Ịkewa okwu agba na okwu ọnụọgụ
l-e-e1-b01-10.goal: Chọpụta nke iwu (otu ozi) dị mkpa n'ezie iji chọta iwu nke kewara kaadị okwu agwakọtara, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-e1-b01-10.material: Kaadị okwu isii agwakọtara: red, seven, blue, nine, green, ten. Kewaa ndị otu udi n'ìgwè abụọ.
l-e-e1-b01-10.s.s1.o.a: Okwu na-akpọ agba na okwu na-akpọ ọnụọgụ
l-e-e1-b01-10.s.s1.o.b: Okwu e dere n'mkpụrụedemede ukwu na okwu e dere n'obere mkpụrụedemede
l-e-e1-b01-10.s.s1.r.b: Kaadị niile ka e dere n'obere mkpụrụedemede, ya mere enweghị ike ịhazi ha n'ụzọ a.
l-e-e1-b01-10.s.s1.o.c: Okwu nwere ọtụtụ mkpụrụedemede na okwu nwere mkpụrụedemede ole na ole
l-e-e1-b01-10.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụlagodi na ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede bụ otu, udi dị iche, ya mere nke a apụghị ịbụ iwu.
l-e-e1-b01-10.s.s1.o.d: Okwu na-amalite site n'mkpụrụedemede sitere n'ihu alphabet
l-e-e1-b01-10.s.s1.r.d: Nke a lere naanị mkpụrụedemede ndị ahụ, ọ bụghị udi. Agba na ọnụọgụ na-agwakọta.
l-e-e1-b01-10.s.s1.explain: red, blue, na green bụ agba, ma seven, nine, na ten bụ ọnụọgụ. A na-akpọkọta ha site n'otu udi.
l-e-e1-b01-10.s.s2.model.0: red, blue, na green na-akpọ agba ma ndị ọzọ na-akpọ ọnụọgụ, ya mere a na-ahazi ha site n'udi.
l-e-e1-b01-10.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede ma ọ bụ mkpụrụedemede ndị ahụ na-agwakọta agba na ọnụọgụ ma ọ naghị adaba, ya mere ị ga-ahazi site n'ihe ọ pụtara.

l-e-e1-b07-06.s.s1.r.b: “How are you?” abụghị ekele ma ọ bụ mgbaghara.
l-e-e1-b07-06.s.s1.o.c: Ahịrịokwu a na-ekwu na mbụ na azịza

l-e-e1-b01-12.material: Nkwuwa okwu kwekọrọ: Stand up. - Sit down. / Open your book. - Close your book. / Come in. - Go out.
l-e-e1-b01-12.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị bụ nkwuwa okwu kwekọrọ maka 'Open the door.'?
l-e-e1-b01-12.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụkwa omume imeghe, ya mere ọ bụghị nke megidere.
l-e-e1-b01-12.s.s1.r.b: Ilele bụ omume nke na-emegideghị imeghe ọnụ ụzọ.
l-e-e1-b01-12.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ otu omume imeghe, ya mere ọ bụghị nke megidere.
l-e-e1-b01-12.s.s1.explain: Ụzọ bụ omume nwere ihe ọ pụtara na-emegide. Ihe megidere imeghe ọnụ ụzọ bụ imechi ọnụ ụzọ.
l-e-e1-b01-12.s.s2.model.0: Ụzọ bụ omume nwere ihe ọ pụtara na-emegide, ya mere Close the door., nke megidere Open, ziri ezi.
l-e-e1-b01-12.s.s2.model.1: Dịka Stand up na Sit down, ha bụ omume na-emegide ibe ha, ya mere ụzọ maka nkwuwa okwu banyere imeghe ọnụ ụzọ bụ nkwuwa okwu banyere imechi ọnụ ụzọ.

l-e-e1-b01-13.title: Iwu ụzọ maka okwu ezinụlọ
l-e-e1-b01-13.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ikpe nke ụzọ okwu ezinụlọ, ma lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-e1-b01-13.material: Kaadị ụzọ: father - mother, brother - sister, grandfather - grandmother, uncle - aunt. Kaadị ikpeazụ bụ son - ?
l-e-e1-b01-13.s.s1.prompt: Site n'ịgbaso iwu ahụ, okwu kedu na-abanye n'?
l-e-e1-b01-13.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ okwu akụkụ nwoke nke apụtalarị. A chọrọ okwu akụkụ nwanyị.
l-e-e1-b01-13.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ okwu akụkụ nwoke nke apụtalarị. A chọrọ okwu akụkụ nwanyị.
l-e-e1-b01-13.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ okwu akụkụ nwoke, ya mere ọ naghị eme ụzọ.
l-e-e1-b01-13.s.s1.explain: Ụzọ bụ okwu akụkụ nwoke na okwu akụkụ nwanyị. Ụzọ maka son (nwa nwoke) bụ daughter (nwa nwanyị).
l-e-e1-b01-13.s.s2.model.0: Ụzọ bụ okwu nwoke na okwu nwanyị, ya mere mgbe son na-abịa okwu akụkụ nwanyị daughter.
l-e-e1-b01-13.s.s2.model.1: Dịka father-mother na brother-sister, nwoke na nwanyị na-eme ụzọ, ya mere ụzọ maka son bụ daughter.

l-e-e1-b01-14.title: Ịchọta ụzọ ekele na azịza
l-e-e1-b01-14.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ikpe nke ụzọ ekele na azịza, ma lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-e1-b01-14.material: Ekele na azịza na-eme ụzọ: Hello! - Hi! / How are you? - I'm fine, thank you. / Nice to meet you. - Nice to meet you, too.
l-e-e1-b01-14.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị bụ azịza ziri ezi maka 'Thank you.'?
l-e-e1-b01-14.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ ekele ụtụtụ, ya mere ọ bụghị azịza maka ekele.
l-e-e1-b01-14.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ ekele maka ịkewa, ya mere ọ bụghị azịza.
l-e-e1-b01-14.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ azịza mgbe mmadụ jụrụ ka ị dị.
l-e-e1-b01-14.s.s1.explain: Nye onye na-ekwu thank you, ị na-aza You're welcome. iji pụta na ọ dị mma.
l-e-e1-b01-14.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe mmadụ na-ekwu thank you, ị na-aza na ọ dị mma, ya mere You're welcome. bụ ụzọ.
l-e-e1-b01-14.s.s2.model.1: Ụzọ bụ azịza kwekọrọ n'ihe e kwuru, ya mere You're welcome. ziri ezi maka Thank you.

l-e-e1-b01-15.s.s1.r.c: Okwu a banyere, ya mere udi dị iche n'ikpe ndị ahụ.

l-e-e1-b02-11.topic: Okwu nwere ụda njedebe yiri ibe ha
l-e-e1-b02-11.goal: Site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke okwu nwere ụda njedebe yiri ibe ha, chọpụta ma kwuo iwu, wee nwalee ya n'ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-e1-b02-11.material: Okwu nwere ụda yiri ibe ha: cat - hat, sun - run, bed - red. Ndị na-enweghị ụda yiri ibe ha: cat - dog, sun - pen.
l-e-e1-b02-11.s.s1.prompt: Kedu okwu nwere ụda njedebe yiri ‘ten’?
l-e-e1-b02-11.s.s1.r.b: Njedebe ya bụ an, ọ bụghị en.
l-e-e1-b02-11.s.s1.r.c: Njedebe ya bụ in, ọ bụghị en.
l-e-e1-b02-11.s.s1.r.d: Njedebe ya bụ op, ọ bụghị en.
l-e-e1-b02-11.s.s1.explain: Okwu nwere ụda yiri ibe ha mgbe njedebe ha bụ otu. Ten na hen abụọ na-ejedebe na en.
l-e-e1-b02-11.s.s2.model.0: Njedebe ahụ ga-abụ otu, dịka cat-hat, ka ụda ha yie; ya mere ten na hen bụ ụzọ okwu kwekọrọ.
l-e-e1-b02-11.s.s2.model.1: Naanị mkpụrụedemede mbụ nke hen dị iche, en bụkwa otu, ya mere ọ na-ada ka ten.

l-e-e1-b02-12.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị ka ị ga-ekwu mgbe ị na-enye ihe dịka nzaghachi nye ‘Can I have a ruler, please?’
l-e-e1-b02-12.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ ekele abalị, ọ bụghị ihe a na-ekwu mgbe a na-enye mmadụ ihe.
l-e-e1-b02-12.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ ihe a na-ekwu mgbe a na-ekewa.
l-e-e1-b02-12.s.s1.explain: Mgbe mmadụ rịọrọ ihe, nye ya ya ma kwuo ‘Here you are.’
l-e-e1-b02-12.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe mmadụ rịọrọ ihe, a na-ekwu ‘Here you are.’ mgbe a na-enyefe ya, ya mere otu a kwa.
l-e-e1-b02-12.s.s2.model.1: N'oge atọ ahụ niile azịza bụ ‘Here you are.’, ya mere otu okwu ahụ dabara maka ruler kwa.

l-e-e1-b02-13.s.s1.r.b: Agbakwunyere is. N'ihe atụ ndị ahụ, naanị 's na-abịa mgbe aha gasịrị.

l-e-e1-b02-13.s.s1.explain: Tinye 's mgbe aha gasịrị, tinyezie okwu ikwu. Ọ bụ Sam's sister.
l-e-e1-b02-13.s.s2.model.0: Dịka ihe atụ, 's na-abịa mgbe aha gasịrị, okwu ikwu abịa n'azụ ya, ya mere ọ bụ Sam's sister.

l-e-e1-b04-11.goal: Chọta iwu n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke mkpụrụedemede nke na-abịa ozugbo mgbe nke ọzọ n'alfabet, kwuo ya, ma lelee ya site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-e1-b04-11.material: N'alfabet, mgbe B bịa C, mgbe D bịa E, ma mgbe M bịa N. Chọta iwu ahụ ma buru amụma mkpụrụedemede mgbe T.
l-e-e1-b04-11.s.s1.prompt: Kedu mkpụrụedemede mgbe T nke dabara n'iwu ahụ?
l-e-e1-b04-11.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ mkpụrụedemede tupu T. Ọ bụ tupu, ọ bụghị mgbe.
l-e-e1-b04-11.s.s1.r.b: Ọ hapụrụ otu ebe. Iwu bụ mkpụrụedemede na-abịa ozugbo mgbe.
l-e-e1-b04-11.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ mkpụrụedemede ikpeazụ. Ọ bụghị ozugbo mgbe T.
l-e-e1-b04-11.s.s1.explain: Ha niile bụ mkpụrụedemede na-abịa ozugbo mgbe. Ozugbo mgbe T bụ U.
l-e-e1-b04-11.s.s2.model.0: B-C, D-E, na M-N niile bụ mkpụrụedemede na-abịa ozugbo mgbe, ya mere mgbe T bịa U.
l-e-e1-b04-11.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụ mgbe niile mkpụrụedemede otu ebe mgbe ya, ya mere mkpụrụedemede mgbe T bụ U.

l-e-e1-b04-12.title: Iwu maka udi okwu mgbe ihe abụọ dị
l-e-e1-b04-12.goal: Chọta iwu n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ka okwu si agbanwe mgbe e nwere ihe karịrị otu, kwuo ya, ma lelee ya site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-e1-b04-12.material: one pen → two pens, one book → two books, one bag → two bags. Chọta iwu ahụ ma kwuo plural maka two desks.
l-e-e1-b04-12.s.s1.prompt: Na-agbaso iwu ahụ, two ___ bụ gịnị?
l-e-e1-b04-12.s.s1.r.a: Ọ gbakwunyere es. N'ihe atụ ndị ahụ, naanị s ka a na-agbakwunye.
l-e-e1-b04-12.s.s1.r.b: Ọ gbakwunyeghị s. N'ihe atụ ndị ahụ, a na-agbakwunye s oge ọ bụla.
l-e-e1-b04-12.s.s1.r.d: Ọ tinyere s n'ihu. S na-aga n'ọgwụgwụ okwu.
l-e-e1-b04-12.s.s1.explain: Mgbe e nwere ihe karịrị otu, gbakwunye s n'ọgwụgwụ okwu. Desk na-aghọ desks.
l-e-e1-b04-12.s.s2.model.0: Dị ka pens, books, bags, a na-agbakwunye s n'ọgwụgwụ, ya mere desk na-aghọkwa desks.
l-e-e1-b04-12.s.s2.model.1: N'ihe atụ atọ niile a na-agbakwunye s n'ọgwụgwụ okwu, ya mere anyị na-ede two desks.

l-e-e1-b04-13.title: Pairs nke okwu nwanyị na okwu nwoke
l-e-e1-b04-13.goal: Chọta iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ ebe okwu nwanyị na okwu nwoke na-eme pair, kwuo ya, ma lelee ya site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-e1-b04-13.material: mother - father, sister - brother, grandmother - grandfather. Chọta iwu ahụ ma buru amụma okwu nke na-eme pair na aunt.
l-e-e1-b04-13.s.s1.prompt: Na-agbaso iwu ahụ, kedu pair nke aunt?
l-e-e1-b04-13.s.s1.r.a: Cousin bụ okwu a na-eji maka ụmụ nwoke na ụmụ nwanyị abụọ.
l-e-e1-b04-13.s.s1.r.c: Dị ka aunt, ọ bụ okwu nwanyị, ya mere ọ nweghị ike ịbụ pair ya.
l-e-e1-b04-13.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ okwu nwoke nke pair dị iche. Ọ bụghị pair nke aunt.
l-e-e1-b04-13.s.s1.explain: A na-ejikọta okwu nwanyị na okwu nwoke. Aunt bụ okwu nwanyị, ya mere pair ya bụ uncle.
l-e-e1-b04-13.s.s2.model.0: Okwu nwanyị na okwu nwoke na-eme pair, ya mere pair nke okwu nwanyị aunt bụ okwu nwoke uncle.
l-e-e1-b04-13.s.s2.model.1: Dị ka mother-father, nwaanyị na nwoke na-eme ụzọ abụọ, ya mere uncle na-adaba na aunt.

l-e-e1-b04-14.goal: Chọta iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ịza ekele site n'otu ekele ahụ, kwuo ya, ma lelee ya site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-e1-b04-14.material: Ọ bụrụ na enyi sị Hello!, za Hello!. Ọ bụrụ na enyi sị Hi!, za Hi!. Ọ bụrụ na enyi sị Good morning!, za Good morning!.
l-e-e1-b04-14.s.s1.prompt: Mgbe enyi sị Good afternoon!, kedu azịza ziri ezi?
l-e-e1-b04-14.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ ekele abalị. Ọ dị iche n'iwu nke ịza site n'otu ekele ahụ.
l-e-e1-b04-14.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ ekele maka ịsị ka ọ dị. Ọ bụghị otu ekele ahụ.
l-e-e1-b04-14.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ ihe anyị na-ekwu mgbe anyị na-ekele. Ọ bụghị otu ekele ahụ.
l-e-e1-b04-14.s.s1.explain: Ọ na-aza site n'otu ekele e natara. Azịza Good afternoon! bụ Good afternoon!.
l-e-e1-b04-14.s.s2.model.0: N'ihe atụ atọ niile, a na-enye ekele e natara azụ dị ka ọ dị, ya mere a na-azakwa Good afternoon! site na Good afternoon!.
l-e-e1-b04-14.s.s2.model.1: Iwu bụ iza site n'otu ekele ahụ, ya mere Good afternoon! bụ azịza ziri ezi nye Good afternoon!.

l-e-e1-b04-15.s.s1.r.b: Ọ toro site n'otu nzọụkwụ. N'ihe atụ ndị ahụ, ọnụọgụ na-eto site n'2.
l-e-e1-b04-15.s.s1.r.c: Ọ toro site n'3. N'ihe atụ ndị ahụ, ọnụọgụ na-eto site n'2.
l-e-e1-b04-15.s.s1.r.d: Ọ toro site n'4. N'ihe atụ ndị ahụ, ọnụọgụ na-eto site n'2.

l-e-e1-b05-11.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ consonant. N'ihe atụ ndị ahụ, etiti bụ vowel.

l-e-e1-b05-13.goal: Chọta iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke iwu maka He na She na-anọchi ndị ezinụlọ, kwuo iwu ahụ, ma lelee ya site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-e1-b05-13.material: He is my father. She is my mother. He is my brother. She is my sister. Chọta iwu ahụ ma buru amụma okwu na-anọchi uncle.
l-e-e1-b05-13.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị dabara n'oghere n'"___ is my uncle." dị ka iwu si dị?
l-e-e1-b05-13.s.s1.r.a: A na-eji okwu a maka nwa agbọghọ ma ọ bụ nwanyị. Uncle bụ onye ezinụlọ nwoke.

l-e-e1-b05-13.s.s1.r.d: A na-eji okwu a maka ihe karịrị otu. Ihe atụ ndị ahụ niile bụ otu onye.
l-e-e1-b05-13.s.s1.explain: He na-anọchi onye ezinụlọ nwoke, ma She na-anọchi onye ezinụlọ nwanyị. Uncle bụ onye ezinụlọ nwoke, ya mere ọ bụ He.
l-e-e1-b05-13.s.s2.model.0: A na-eji He maka ndị ezinụlọ nwoke, ya mere jiri He maka uncle, onye bụkwa onye ezinụlọ nwoke.
l-e-e1-b05-13.s.s2.model.1: Otu onye nwoke, dị ka father ma ọ bụ brother, bụ He, ya mere He na-anọchikwa uncle.

l-e-e1-b05-14.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ aha ihe. Ihe atụ ndị ahụ niile bụ mmetụta ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ ahụ.

l-e-e1-b06-11.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ na-awụlikwa mkpụrụedemede abụọ. Ihe atụ ndị ahụ na-awụlikwa naanị otu mkpụrụedemede.
l-e-e1-b06-11.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ mkpụrụedemede tupu G.

l-e-e1-b06-15.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu maka okwu ọnụọgụ na-eto site na 5 oge ọ bụla site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ, ma lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-e1-b06-15.material: Okwu ọnụọgụ ndị ahụ na-aga n'usoro five, ten, fifteen, twenty. Chọta iwu ahụ ma buru amụma okwu ọnụọgụ na-esote.
l-e-e1-b06-15.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ gbakwunyere 10. Ihe atụ ndị ahụ na-eto site na 5.
l-e-e1-b06-15.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ gbakwunyere 1. Ihe atụ ndị ahụ na-eto site na 5.

l-e-e1-b06-15.s.s2.model.0: Ọnụọgụ ndị ahụ na-eto site na 5, ya mere mgbe twenty bịa twenty-five, nke bụ 5 karịa 20.

l-e-e1-b07-02.title: Olee otú a ga-esi gụọ ụda vowel mgbe e tinyere e na njedebe?
l-e-e1-b07-02.goal: Chọpụta ma kwuo iwu ịgụ vowel n’okwu nwere e na njedebe site n’ọtụtụ ihe atụ, jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nyochaa iwu ahụ.
l-e-e1-b07-02.material: Mgbe e tinyere e, ụda na-agbanwe. cap (ụda a dị mkpirikpi) → cape (ụda a ogologo), kit (ụda i mkpirikpi) → kite (ụda i ogologo), hop (ụda o mkpirikpi) → hope (ụda o ogologo). Chọta iwu, gụọ pine.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.prompt: Ọ bụrụ iwu ahụ ziri ezi, olee otú ị ga-esi gụọ i n’ime pine, nke bụ pin e tinyere e?
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.o.a: Gụọ ya dịka aha mkpụrụedemede i, ụda “eye” ogologo.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.o.b: Gụọ ya mkpirikpi dịka pin, ụda “ih.”
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ bụ ụda mkpirikpi tupu e etinye ya. Ọ na-atụfu iwu ahụ.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.o.c: Gụọ ya ogologo dịka ụda e, “ee.”
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.r.c: A gụrụ ya dịka ụda aha mkpụrụedemede e a gbakwunyere. Nke ahụ dị iche na iwu ahụ.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.r.d: Ụda i na-agbanwe, ọ bụghị ụda e.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.explain: Mgbe e tinyere e, vowel dị n’etiti na-eji ụda aha mkpụrụedemede ya. Cape nwere ụda “ay,” kite nwere “eye,” hope nwekwara “oh.”
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s2.model.0: N’ime cape, kite, hope, vowel etiti na-eji ụda aha mkpụrụedemede ya mgbe e tinyere e. Ya mere i dị n’ime pine na-agụ “eye.”
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s2.model.1: N’okwu atọ niile, mgbe e tinyere e na njedebe, vowel na-adị ogologo dịka aha ya; ya mere mgbe pin ghọrọ pine, i na-agụ “eye.”

l-e-e1-b07-09.title: Iwu maka okwu nọmba na-ejedebe na “ty”
l-e-e1-b07-09.goal: Lee ọtụtụ ihe atụ otú okwu nọmba na-abawanye 10 si akwụsị, chọta iwu kwuo ya, nyochaa ya site n’ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-e1-b07-09.material: Site na 20 gaa n’ihu, nọmba na-abawanye 10. 20 → twenty, 30 → thirty, 40 → forty, 50 → fifty. Chọta iwu, kwuo nọmba na-esote n’asụsụ Bekee.
l-e-e1-b07-09.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ “six” na “ten” jikọtara ọnụ. O nweghị okwu dị otú ahụ.
l-e-e1-b07-09.s.s1.explain: 20, 30, 40, 50 niile na-ejedebe na “ty.” “Sixty,” nke bụ six tinyere “ty,” bụ 60. [6]
l-e-e1-b07-09.s.s2.model.0: 20, 30, 40, 50 niile na-ejedebe na “ty,” ya mere 60 bụkwa “sixty,” nke bụ “six” gbakwunyere “ty.”
l-e-e1-b07-09.s.s2.model.1: “Sixteen” bụ 16, “sixth” pụtara nke isii n’usoro; ya mere ha ezighi ezi. Dịka iwu si dị, “sixty,” nke na-ejedebe na “ty,” ziri ezi.

l-e-e1-b01-16.title: Ihe dị ka consonants ole dị?
l-e-e1-b01-16.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ consonants n'alphabet iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e1-b01-16.material: Alphabet nwere mkpụrụedemede 26 n'ozuzu. Vowels bụ mkpụrụedemede ise a, e, i, o, u, mkpụrụedemede ndị na-abụghị vowels bụkwa consonants.
l-e-e1-b01-16.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dị ka consonants ole dị n'ozuzu?
l-e-e1-b01-16.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ ọnụọgụ vowels. Consonants bụ mkpụrụedemede fọdụrụ.
l-e-e1-b01-16.s.s1.r.b: Nke a tụrụ atụmatụ ọkara nke ngụkọta. Vowels dị ole na ole karịa.
l-e-e1-b01-16.s.s1.r.d: Nke a chere na ha niile bụ consonants. E nwere vowels kwa.
l-e-e1-b01-16.s.s1.explain: N'ime 26, 5 bụ vowels, ya mere e nwere ihe dị ka consonants 21.
l-e-e1-b01-16.s.s2.model.0: Iwepụ vowels 5 n'26 na-ahapụ 21, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 21.
l-e-e1-b01-16.s.s2.model.1: E nwere naanị vowels 5 ma ndị ọzọ bụ consonants, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 21, ntakịrị n'okpuru 26.

l-e-e1-b03-19.title: Olu maka ekele enyi dị anya
l-e-e1-b03-19.goal: Tụọ anya olu a ga-eji ekele enyi dị anya, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-e1-b03-19.material: Enyi na-eguzo n'akụkụ ọzọ nke ogige egwuregwu. Ịchọrọ ikwu 'Hello!' ka enyi gị nụ gị.
l-e-e1-b03-19.s.s1.prompt: Olu gị kwesịrị ịdị ike ole?
l-e-e1-b03-19.s.s1.o.a: N'olu ike, ka a nụ ya n'ebe dị anya
l-e-e1-b03-19.s.s1.o.b: Dị ka ikwu okwu na onye nọ nso gị
l-e-e1-b03-19.s.s1.r.b: Olu maka ikwu okwu na onye nọ nso adịghị anụ n'akụkụ ọzọ.
l-e-e1-b03-19.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na ị emeghị ụda, ekele gị agaghị erute enyi gị.
l-e-e1-b03-19.s.s1.o.d: N'olu dị nwayọọ, dị ka mkpọtụ
l-e-e1-b03-19.s.s1.r.d: Ụda dị nwayọọ adịghị anụ site n'ebe dị anya.
l-e-e1-b03-19.s.s1.explain: Mgbe mmadụ dị anya, ụda na-agbada. Ị ga-ekwu okwu n'olu ike ka a nụ ya n'akụkụ ọzọ.
l-e-e1-b03-19.s.s2.model.0: Enyi dị anya na-anụ ụda ka ọ na-adị nta, ya mere ị ga-ekwu okwu n'olu ike.
l-e-e1-b03-19.s.s2.model.1: Ọ ga-anụ n'akụkụ ọzọ, ya mere kelee n'olu ike ka a nụ ya n'ebe dị anya.

l-e-e1-b04-16.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ ahịrị achọrọ iji dee mkpụrụedemede 26 nke alfabet, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e1-b04-16.material: Alfabet nwere mkpụrụedemede 26 n'ozuzu. Ị chọrọ ide mkpụrụedemede 10 n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ ahịrị achọrọ iji dee mkpụrụedemede niile.
l-e-e1-b04-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ ahịrị achọrọ kwesịrị ekwesị?
l-e-e1-b04-16.s.s1.r.a: Ahịrị 1 na-ejide naanị mkpụrụedemede 10. Mkpụrụedemede 26 niile adabaghị.
l-e-e1-b04-16.s.s1.r.b: Na ahịrị 10 ị nwere ike ide ihe dị ka mkpụrụedemede 100. Nke ahụ dị ukwuu.
l-e-e1-b04-16.s.s1.r.d: Na ahịrị 26 ị nwere ike ide ihe dị ka mkpụrụedemede 260. Nke ahụ dị ukwuu.
l-e-e1-b04-16.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị abụọ na-ejide mkpụrụedemede 20, mkpụrụedemede 6 fọdụrụ. Ya mere a chọrọ ahịrị 3.
l-e-e1-b04-16.s.s2.model.0: Ahịrị abụọ na-ejide mkpụrụedemede 20, nke dị obere karịa mkpụrụedemede 26, ya mere ahịrị 3 kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-e1-b04-16.s.s2.model.1: 26 karịrị 20 ma dị obere karịa 30, ya mere ahịrị 3 nke mkpụrụedemede 10 ọ bụla ga-ezuru.

l-e-e1-b04-17.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ igbe pensụl a ga-enye ụmụ akwụkwọ 20, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-e1-b04-17.material: Otu igbe pensụl na-ejide pensụl 6. Ị chọrọ inye otu pensụl nye ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 ọ bụla. Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ igbe achọrọ.
l-e-e1-b04-17.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ igbe achọrọ kwesịrị ekwesị?
l-e-e1-b04-17.s.s1.r.a: Igbe 2 na-eme pensụl 12. Nke ahụ ezughị maka ụmụ akwụkwọ 20.
l-e-e1-b04-17.s.s1.r.c: Igbe 10 na-eme pensụl 60. Nke ahụ dị ukwuu.
l-e-e1-b04-17.s.s1.r.d: Igbe 20 na-eme pensụl 120. Nke ahụ dị ukwuu.
l-e-e1-b04-17.s.s1.explain: Igbe 3 na-eme pensụl 18, ya mere ụmụ akwụkwọ 2 fọdụrụ na-enweghị. Ya mere a chọrọ igbe 4.
l-e-e1-b04-17.s.s2.model.0: Igbe 3 na-eme pensụl 18, nke dị obere karịa ụmụ akwụkwọ 20, ya mere igbe 4 kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-e1-b04-17.s.s2.model.1: Igbe 4 nke pensụl 6 ọ bụla na-eme pensụl 24, ya mere ị nwere ike inye otu pensụl nye ụmụ akwụkwọ 20 ọ bụla.

l-e-e1-b04-18.material: Kwa ụtụtụ ị na-ekwu Good morning nye ndị ezinụlọ 3. Tụọ atụmatụ ekele ole ị na-eme n'otu izu (ụbọchị 7).
l-e-e1-b04-18.s.s1.r.a: Ugboro 3 bụ maka otu ụbọchị naanị. Maka ụbọchị 7 ọ karịrị nke ukwuu.
l-e-e1-b04-18.s.s1.r.b: Ugboro 100 bụ ihe dị ka ugboro 14 n'ụbọchị. Nke ahụ dị ukwuu.
l-e-e1-b04-18.s.s1.explain: Ugboro 3 n'ụbọchị maka ụbọchị 7 bụ 3 x 7 = 21, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka ugboro 20.

l-e-e1-b04-19.s.s1.r.a: N'sekọnd 10 ị na-ekele naanị mmadụ 2. Nke ahụ dị mkpụmkpụ nke ukwuu.
l-e-e1-b04-19.s.s1.r.b: Nkeji 10 bụ sekọnd 600. Nke ahụ dị ogologo nke ukwuu.
l-e-e1-b04-19.s.s1.r.c: Awa 1 bụ sekọnd 3600. Nke ahụ dị ogologo nke ukwuu.

l-e-e1-b06-18.s.s1.r.c: 100L bụ ihe dị ka iko 500. Nke ahụ dị ukwuu nke ukwuu.
l-e-e1-b06-18.s.s1.r.d: 10L bụ ihe dị ka iko 50. Nke ahụ dị ukwuu nke ukwuu.

l-e-e1-b06-19.s.s1.r.c: Maka awa 5, ị ga-abụrịrị ya ihe dị ka ugboro 300.

l-e-e1-b07-08.topic: Ihe dị ka apụl ole dị?
l-e-e1-b07-08.goal: Tụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ apụl dị n’igbe, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè dabara, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-e1-b07-08.material: A haziri apụl 5 n’ahịrị n’ime igbe. Ahịrị 4 juputara, ma ahịrị ikpeazụ nwere oghere 1. Ka anyị tụọ ya site n’okwu nọmba Bekee.
l-e-e1-b07-08.s.s1.prompt: Apụl ole dị n’ozuzu dịka atụmatụ gị? Kedu atụmatụ kacha dabara?
l-e-e1-b07-08.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ ọnụ ọgụgụ otu ahịrị naanị. E nwere ahịrị 4.
l-e-e1-b07-08.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ ọnụ ọgụgụ ahịrị abụọ naanị. E nwere ahịrị 4.
l-e-e1-b07-08.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ karịrị akarị. Oche 5 n’ime ahịrị 4 ọ bụla bụ ihe dị ka 20.
l-e-e1-b07-08.s.s1.explain: Apụl 5 n’ime ahịrị 4 bụ 20; oghere 1 efu, ya bụ 19. Dịka atụmatụ, ọ bụ ihe dị ka twenty.
l-e-e1-b07-08.s.s2.model.0: Apụl 5 n’ime ahịrị 4 bụ 20, naanị oghere 1 efu, ya mere ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ 20. “About twenty” kacha dabara.
l-e-e1-b07-08.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrị ọ bụla nwere 5, e nwere ahịrị 4, ya mere ngụkọta dị nso 20. N’ihi ya “about twenty” ka “about ten” ma ọ bụ “about five” mma.

l-e-e1-b07-04.title: Nkọwa gụrụ “Sit down” dịka “Stand up”
l-e-e1-b07-04.topic: Nkọwa buru ụzọ chepụta ihe ọ pụtara site n’akwụkwọ ozi mbụ
l-e-e1-b07-04.goal: Soro usoro echiche ma ọ bụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ mgbe a nụrụ “Sit down.”, chọta ebe mbụ o dara, mezie ya.
l-e-e1-b07-04.material: Sam nụrụ ka onye nkuzi kwuru “Sit down.” Sam chere: 1) Sit na Stand abụọ na-amalite na S. 2) Ya mere okwu abụọ ahụ pụtara otu ihe. 3) Ya mere Sam guzoro ọtọ.
l-e-e1-b07-04.s.s1.o.a: 1) Nkwupụta na ha abụọ na-amalite na S
l-e-e1-b07-04.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ eziokwu. Ọ bụghị ebe njehie malitere.
l-e-e1-b07-04.s.s1.o.b: 2) Nkwupụta na ha pụtara otu ihe
l-e-e1-b07-04.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ nsonaazụ echiche na-ezighi ezi dị na 2).
l-e-e1-b07-04.s.s1.r.d: “Sit down.” pụtara ịnọdụ ala, ya mere iguzo ọtọ ezighi ezi.
l-e-e1-b07-04.s.s1.explain: Ọbụna ma mkpụrụedemede mbụ hà, ihe ha pụtara dị iche. Sit pụtara ịnọdụ, Stand pụtara iguzo.
l-e-e1-b07-04.s.s2.model.0: Njehie dị na 2), ebe o kwuru na ihe ha pụtara bụ otu n’ihi na mkpụrụedemede mbụ hà. Sit pụtara ịnọdụ ala, ya mere “Sit down” pụtara na ị ga-anọdụ.
l-e-e1-b07-04.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụ ihe na-ezighi ezi n’ihi na Sit na Stand nwere ihe dị iche n’agbanyeghị na ha abụọ na-amalite na S. Iji mezie ya: Sit pụtara ịnọdụ ala, ya mere Sam nọdụ ala.

l-e-e1-b01-26.s.s1.explain: Ọ pụtara na mkpụrụedemede mbụ nke apple bụ A. Starts with pụtara ‘na-amalite na’.

l-e-e1-b06-30.material: Otu aka nwere mkpịsị aka niile elu (5), ma aka nke ọzọ nwere naanị mkpịsị aka 2 elu. Ịchọrọ ịgbanwe ọnụọgụ mkpịsị aka dị elu ka ọ bụrụ okwu ọnụọgụ Bekee.

l-e-e1-b06-30.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ ọnụọgụ na-agụ naanị mkpịsị aka nke aka nke ọzọ.
l-e-e1-b06-30.s.s1.explain: 5 + 2 = 7, ya mere mkpịsị aka 7 dị elu. N'asụsụ Bekee ọ bụ seven.

l-e-e1-b06-30.s.s2.model.1: 5 sitere n'otu aka tinye 2 sitere n'aka nke ọzọ na-eme 7, ya mere seven ziri ezi.

l-e-e1-b07-07.title: Ime “Thank you very much” ka ọ dị mkpirikpi
l-e-e1-b07-07.goal: Gbanwee ekele ka ọ bụrụ nke dị mkpirikpi dabara enyi, kọwaa ihe mere ihe ọ pụtara ji bụrụ otu.
l-e-e1-b07-07.material: Jun kwuru “Thank you very much.” nye onye nkuzi. Ugbu a Jun chọrọ ikwu otu ihe ahụ n’ụzọ nkịtị dị mkpirikpi nye enyi binyere ya pensụl.
l-e-e1-b07-07.s.s1.prompt: Okwu mkpirikpi dị aṅaa nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara?
l-e-e1-b07-07.s.s1.r.a: “Thank” naanị ya abụghị ahịrịokwu zuru ezu.
l-e-e1-b07-07.s.s1.r.b: Ọ pụtara “I’m sorry,” nke dị iche na ekele.
l-e-e1-b07-07.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ azịza nye ekele; ya mere ihe ọ pụtara dị iche.
l-e-e1-b07-07.s.s1.explain: “Thanks!” bụ ụdị mkpirikpi nke “Thank you.”, a na-ejikwa ya n’ụzọ nkịtị n’etiti ndị enyi. Ihe ekele ka bụ otu.
l-e-e1-b07-07.s.s2.model.0: “Thanks!” bụ ụdị mkpirikpi nke “Thank you”; mmetụta ekele ka bụ otu.
l-e-e1-b07-07.s.s2.model.1: “Sorry!” na “You're welcome!” nwere ihe dị iche, ya mere ha adabaghị; “Thanks!” na-egosipụta otu ekele ahụ, ya mere ọ dabara.
